en: The front of the postcard features a sepia-toned photograph of a woman dressed in an elaborate, somewhat orientalist costume, holding a platter above her head with what appears to be a head on it, referencing the biblical story of Salome. The text on the front reads 'Aline Sanden Salome.' The reverse side has printed information at the top from 'Hoffmann & Jursch, Photogr. Atelier. Leipzig, Dorotheenstr. 10 p.' along with handwritten German text dated March 11, 1911.
